    AI Overview
    Yes, Rory McIlroy is married to Erica Stoll. The couple tied the knot on April 22, 2017, at Ashford Castle in Ireland. Although McIlroy filed for divorce in May 2024, the petition was voluntarily withdrawn shortly after, and they have continued their marriage, frequently appearing together at events, including the 2026 Masters. 
    Key Details About Their Relationship: 
    • How They Met: They met in 2012 at the Ryder Cup, where Stoll, then a PGA transport official, helped McIlroy avoid missing his tee time.
    • Family: They have one daughter together, named Poppy, born in 2020.
    • Privacy: According to People.com, Stoll is known to be a very private person who generally stays out of the media spotlight.
    • Divorce Withdrawal: While divorce papers were filed in 2024, the pair resolved their differences and reconciled, as confirmed by Yahoo Entertainment and The Augusta Chronicle.
